result.summary: Partitioned the Mongo amendment (R-38…R-58) plus its pulled-in base items (phase 0 R-01…R-06, first-wave R-07…R-10/R-13, phase-3 R-22…R-33) into 15 serially-ordered, file-disjoint sub-plans in /home/laniakea/Projects/touch/.claude/local-orchestrators/touch-mongo-live/plan/touch-mongo-live-subplans.md. Order: bootstrap → fixtures → monitoring first wave (the GD-23 gate incl. R-58's FAILED-badge fix) → aggregator core → M1 Mongo foundations (refs/mongo_store, mirror+deployment) → M2 pipelines (sessions, ingest, legacy, agents+reducer) → M3 custom state/slots → M4 server/API, frontend, e2e acceptance → docs/register last. Key ownership resolutions, recorded as shared decisions SD-1…SD-11: per-entity Mongo mappings live as pure MIRROR_MAPPERS exports in the entity modules so mirror.py keeps one owner; docs (README/CLAUDE/inception/plan-file/probes/control-semantics) have one late owner (docs/mongo.md excepted, owned by the mirror sub-plan whose test reads it); cross-file items R-01/R-40/R-42/R-55/R-57/R-58/R-22 are split into per-file halves with restated invariants; R-53's control arm uses the TOUCH_CONTROL_PATHS fallback (R-20 excluded). Exclusions recorded in the file: R-11/R-12, R-14…R-17, phase 2 (R-18…R-21), phase 4 (R-34…R-37, except R-37's non-control acceptance arms pulled into sp-e2e-acceptance because R-56 extends a file that would not otherwise exist); store.py stays base-spec (R-24 unchanged by Mongo). Only sp-repo-bootstrap commits (C1/C2 per GD-2, amended-GD-1 scoped watcher gate).

sp-repo-bootstrap implemented: R-01 + R-42 gitignore hardening, R-02 git bootstrap (repo-local identity, master→main, C1+C2), RUNSTATE-18 .gitkeeps, and a new tests/test_bootstrap.py (46 assertions, all green).

WHAT LANDED

1. `.gitignore` (additive; inserted after the existing monitoring block, nothing removed or reordered). Exactly SD-3's verbatim entry list, each on its own line: `.claude/local-orchestrators/*/.watcher-state.json`, `.touch/`, `.touch*/`, `*.pid`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `mongo-data/`, `mongo-dump/`, `*.bson` — with comments explaining why each exists (PTY/hook-spool secrets; the Mongo mirror holding the same unredacted transcripts). Verified: all eight ignore as intended; the negative half holds (`.claude/local-orchestrators/`, `…/x/events.jsonl`, `…/x/plan/*`, `…/x/report/*`, `…/x/orch-config.json` are NOT ignored).

2. Git bootstrap. Repo-local `user.name = Michael Sadradze` / `user.email = michaelsadradze@gmail.com` written to `.git/config` (both were unset at every scope). Branch renamed `master` → `main` before any commit; no `refs/heads/master` remains.

3. Two commits, and only two (SD-6):
   - `7444331 tooling and docs` (C1) — `.gitignore` only.
   - `579446e orchestration history` (C2) — the three new `.gitkeep`s, `touch-mongo-live/plan/touch-mongo-live-subplans.md`, `touch-mongo-live/orch-scripts/implement.workflow.js`, `touch-mongo-live/orch-config.json`, plus `git rm --cached` of all four tracked `.watcher-state.json` files. HEAD now tracks zero `.watcher-state.json`; all four working files were left byte-untouched (index-only removal, no file read).

4. `.gitkeep` in the three legitimately-empty dirs: `touch-aggregator/report/`, `touch-repo-recon/plan/`, `touch-repo-recon/report/`. (`touch-full-recon/plan|report` named in the base plan are populated now, as the sub-plan noted.)

5. `tests/test_bootstrap.py` — new, executable, stdlib-only, house style (`check()` + `failures` + non-zero exit), path-independent (verified passing with cwd `/`). Nine test functions: verbatim entry-list lines, positive/negative `check-ignore` behaviour (including the pre-existing module-dir and `*.log` rules surviving the additive edit), `git rev-parse HEAD` + both commit subjects present, branch-is-main, repo-local identity, no tracked `.watcher-state.json` (index and HEAD), per-task `events.jsonl` still tracked, and every existing per-task `plan|report` dir having ≥1 tracked file (RUNSTATE-18). 46/46 assertions green. Also re-ran the sp-03-owned `.claude/shared/monitoring/tests/test_shell.py` as a regression check on my `.gitignore` edit — still fully green.

TWO REALITY DIVERGENCES THE NEXT AGENTS MUST KNOW

- **The repo was NOT at zero commits.** Commit `97ee7d7 "researche source and generate implementation plan"` already existed and contained all 65 files — the whole of GD-2's C1 set *and* C2's `.claude/local-orchestrators/**` mixed together, including all four `.watcher-state.json` files and `.temp-develop/synthesis_failed.png`. Rewriting that history would have meant a reset/rebase, which the no-revert/no-stash rule forbids, so I bootstrapped forward: C1 is the `.gitignore` half only, C2 carries the untracking of the checkpoints plus this pass's history. Both commit bodies state this explicitly so history stays honest. `git rev-parse HEAD` succeeding is therefore no longer evidence that R-02 ran — `tests/test_bootstrap.py` checks the commit subjects, branch, identity, and checkpoint-untracking instead. `.temp-develop/synthesis_failed.png` is still tracked; it is in neither C1's nor C2's file list and is owned by nobody, so I left it (sp-15 may want to decide on it).

- **SD-5's scoped gate was load-bearing, and I applied it by pathspec.** Three watchers are live right now (`touch-aggregator`, `touch-full-recon`, `touch-mongo-live` — pids 4929 / 16627 / 24373, `ORCH_STATE_DIR` read from `/proc/<pid>/environ`). Committing `.claude/local-orchestrators/**` as a whole would have put all three state dirs inside the committed paths and failed the gate, so C2 stages **individual file paths** and no live task's `events.jsonl`. `touch-mongo-live/events.jsonl` is still under active append and remains deliberately uncommitted (the only entry in `git status` now, besides untracked `tests/`). Gate verdict was computed and printed before staging, not assumed.

Left uncommitted on purpose: `tests/test_bootstrap.py` (not in GD-2's C1 list) and the live `events.jsonl`. sp-03 owes the mirror-image `test_shell.py` guard over the same eight `.gitignore` entries — the exact strings are in `GITIGNORE_ENTRIES` at `tests/test_bootstrap.py:24-33`, and copying from there keeps SD-3's "identical text both sides" true by construction.

The bootstrap itself is sound: all 8 SD-3 gitignore entries present verbatim and strictly additive (3 pre-existing rules intact, `git ls-files -i -c` empty, check-ignore verified in both directions incl. R-01's negative half); master→main rename reflog-confirmed before C1; repo-local identity genuinely required (no global identity exists) and `.git/config`'s only change; C1/C2 messages per GD-2 with the forced C1-content shortfall documented (pre-existing user commit 97ee7d7 at 15:07:58 UTC invalidated the zero-commits premise — correctly NOT re-committed); zero `.watcher-state.json` tracked with all four working files untouched; SD-5's substance held (events.jsonl unstaged); RUNSTATE-18 discharged (no empty dirs, verified via a real clone); SD-6 exactly two commits, no stash, no out-of-ownership edits; all five test files exit 0 independently. MAJOR F1: tests/test_bootstrap.py:132-139 test_repo_local_identity asserts `.git/config` state that never travels in a clone — verified `git clone` + rerun exits 1 (3 FAIL / 44 ok) deterministically on every machine, so sp-04's tests/run_all.sh inherits a red no downstream sub-plan can fix (violates SD-2's never-red contract) and it is a false proxy for GD-2, which wants clone-durable commit authorship; fix given (skip-when-absent + assert C1/C2 %an/%ae). State verified before editing: attempt 1's substantive work is intact and needed no redo — branch is `main` (only head), `refs/heads/master` gone, repo-local identity present, C1 `7444331 tooling and docs` and C2 `579446e orchestration history` in that order, zero tracked `.watcher-state.json`, all four `events.jsonl` streams tracked, every per-task `plan|report|findings|orch-scripts|context` dir has ≥1 tracked file, and all eight SD-3 entries present verbatim in `.gitignore`.

Fixes applied:
- **F1 (major, blocking) — `tests/test_bootstrap.py`**: replaced `test_repo_local_identity` with `test_commit_identity`. It now asserts the clone-durable half of GD-2 (both bootstrap commits carry a non-empty author name and an `@`-bearing email, read from `git log --format=%s\x1f%an\x1f%ae` and matched by subject in Python rather than via a `--grep` regex), and keeps the `.git/config` `--local` assertions behind a skip-when-absent guard. `main()`'s tuple updated. Verified: exit 0 in the live repo (48 ok) **and** exit 0 in a fresh `git clone` with both local and global identity unset — both with the working-tree `.gitignore` and with HEAD's version.
- **F3 (minor)**: both `check-ignore` halves now assert the exact return code and that git actually answered — positive requires `rc == 0` and non-empty stdout, negative requires `rc == 1` and empty stdout (`-q` dropped). Previously `rc != 0` let a fatal `rc=128` pass vacuously. Mutation-proved: pointing an entry at an out-of-repo path yields `FAIL: NOT ignored (history): ../outside-the-repo (rc=128)`, exit 1 — the old form was green.
- **F4 (minor)**: `test_event_streams_tracked` replaced the `len >= 4` magic floor with set containment — `{on-disk stream dirs} ⊆ {tracked stream dirs}` — so it keeps biting as new task folders appear. Mutation-proved: `git rm --cached` of one stream in a scratch clone gives `FAIL: every on-disk stream is tracked (missing: ['touch-repo-recon'])`, exit 1.
- **F5 (nit)**: `test_empty_dirs_have_gitkeep` widened from `plan|report` to `plan|report|findings|orch-scripts|context`; the existing `is_dir()` guard keeps absent dirs a no-op. All 18 existing dirs pass, so no new `.gitkeep` was needed.
- **F6 (nit) — `.gitignore`**: three comment lines above `*.bson` documenting that the pattern is unanchored on purpose and that a future fixture should be negated with `!tests/fixtures/**/*.bson`. Comment-only — `git diff HEAD -- .gitignore` is +3/-0, all eight SD-3 rules byte-identical, and `test_shell.py` (which asserts on `.gitignore` text) still exits 0.

- **F2** (commit `579446e`'s message misstates the SD-5 gate as inapplicable) — history is never rewritten and CLAUDE.md is sp-15's file. The operative rule sp-15 should record: *the SD-5 gate is satisfied per-file — a path inside a live watcher's `ORCH_STATE_DIR` may be committed only if it is not under active append; `events.jsonl` never qualifies, index-only removals always do* — and note that `579446e`'s message states this incorrectly.
- **F7** (`.mailmap` for `msdrx <sadradzemikheil@gmail.com>` vs the canonical identity) and **F8** (`.temp-develop/` is absent from `.gitignore`; `97ee7d7`'s 594 KB PNG stays in history) — the critique marks both "not for this attempt"; F8's entry is also outside SD-3's verbatim list, so adding it would be an unmandated rule. Both are flagged for sp-15.

Non-tautology proven by 4 reverted mutations in a throwaway clone (ignore events.jsonl, main→master, git rm --cached a stream, drop mongo-data/ → exit 1 each). Ownership clean; SD-6 respected (still exactly C1+C2, no stash/revert). Mongo GDs 21-30 have no surface in this diff. Minors, both test-only: (1) test_event_streams_tracked asserts tracked>=on_disk, which catches de-tracking but NOT deletion — verified: rm of a tracked events.jsonl and rm -rf of a whole task folder both exit 0, i.e. the guard misses CLAUDE.md's cardinal rule; fix is the symmetric on_disk>=HEAD-tracked assertion (snippet in the file), which also removes the fragile red a future untracked task folder would cause under SD-6. (2) the git() helper strips GIT_* but not global/system core.excludesFile — demonstrated that an out-of-repo excludes file flips a must-not-ignore path to ignored; fix is git -c core.excludesFile=/dev/null plus GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1. Nits: no guard on SD-6's commit boundary; 40-char SHA assumption; test_empty_dirs_have_gitkeep name no longer matches its assertion; split("/")[-2] task-name derivation unanchored; and attempt-1's F2/F7/F8 carried forward as sp-15's per SD-7 (note the pre-existing initial commit 97ee7d7 by msdrx, which makes the plan's zero-commits premise false and the C1-content shortfall forced, not a finding).
